decisions.reason: The format reader and writer plug-ins are a visible product line with their own page and fit the firm's core data integration business, so they are likely to be maintained.
The open GIS application development framework underpins the firm's open, extensible component strategy and its customer projects, although it is only mentioned on the website rather than featured.
The newly launched consulting workshop has its own page, needs little capital and builds on the firm's consulting and training strengths, so it is worth keeping.
